resources.string: Swap two neighbouring gems, or tap one and then the next, so three or more of the same kind line up. Matched gems vanish and new ones drop in.
Match four to make a Flare that clears a line, five for a Prism that clears one colour, and an L or T shape for a Burst that clears a block around it.
Chains are the secret. When new gems fall into a match by themselves, every link in the chain scores more than the last.
Pick a game type in the Hub: Classic, Zen, Lightning, Quest, Twist, Mine, Butterflies or Countdown. Quest levels have goals and obstacles such as ice, cages, stones and bombs.
Stuck? Tap Hint. Boosters are free but limited in each game. One-switch mode scans the board for you so a single button can play.
The word gem comes from the Latin gemma, which meant both a jewel and a bud on a plant.
